records.title: Loans under Pradhan Mantri Van Dhan Yojana
details: f: To increase the reach and effectiveness of the scheme, the Ministry is proposing to increase the maximum funds provided to each VDVKs.

records.title: Allocation of funds under Poshan Programme
details: (b) Further, the Government has also decided to upgrade all Mini AWCs with one worker to full-fledged Anganwadi Centres with one worker and one helper each.
